summary: Five viable used‑SUV candidates found meeting criteria (model year ≥2020, under 40k miles, strong reliability) in Philadelphia / SE PA / South Jersey region. Includes 2020 Toyota RAV4 LE (≈39.9 k mi), 2022 Subaru Forester Premium AWD (≈14.3 k mi), and multiple 2022 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD listings (mileage range ~34.6k–37k). No newer hybrids surfaced with compelling evidence; add‑ons and history verification needed.
